recommendation.justification: Satellite imagery shows critical canopy decline (NDVI 0.154) and acute water stress (NDWI -0.204), which threaten photosynthesis and fruit set. Soil analysis confirms optimal pH and texture but low organic carbon, increasing erosion and disease risk. Market prices are rising, so rapid corrective action can preserve yield and capture profitability.
actions: 1. Conduct a ground‑truth walk of the orchard to identify any disease symptoms (e.g., anthracnose, powdery mildew) or nutrient deficiencies; record observations.
2. Increase drip‑irrigation flow immediately to meet the mango fruiting stage requirement (water every 5–7 days), ensuring uniform coverage of the root zone.
3. Apply 5–10 cm of well‑decomposed compost or manure around the base of each tree to raise organic carbon and improve moisture retention.
4. Install a mulch layer (straw or shredded leaves) over the soil surface to reduce evaporation, moderate soil temperature, and protect against erosion.
5. Adjust fertilizer application if needed, maintaining the recommended NPK 10:10:10 balance, but avoid excess nitrogen that could exacerbate water stress.
6. Document all actions in a field log with dates, quantities, and observations.

actions: 1. Conduct a ground‑truth walk of the orchard to identify any disease symptoms (e.g., anthracnose, powdery mildew) or nutrient deficiencies; record observations.
2. Increase drip‑irrigation flow immediately to meet the mango fruiting stage requirement (water every 5–7 days), ensuring uniform coverage of the root zone.
3. Apply 5–10 cm of well‑decomposed compost or manure around the base of each tree to raise organic carbon and improve moisture retention.
4. Install a mulch layer (straw or shredded leaves) over the soil surface to reduce evaporation, moderate soil temperature, and protect against erosion.
5. Adjust fertilizer application if needed, maintaining the recommended NPK 10:10:10 balance, but avoid excess nitrogen that could exacerbate water stress.
6. Document all actions in a field log with dates, quantities, and observations.
